sentences: This is my Downloads folder. Everything important I own is in here somewhere.
My rent contract, three months of bills, the medical note the university asked me for twice.
All of them called things like document five, or I M G four four three one.

scenes.headline: One tap files a whole folder
bullets: The whole sort can be undone
scenes.record: Documents tab with the corpus folder linked. Tap Sort, let the progress run, then show the new folders and the review queue. End on the Undo button.
sentences: So I tap sort. Once.
Dewey opens every file and reads it, right on the phone. French, Arabic, English, even photos of paper.
It can tell a bill from a contract from a doctor's note, makes the folders, and puts everything away.
The two it wasn't sure about, it left alone and flagged them, because the wrong folder is worse than no folder.
Nothing got uploaded. And one tap puts it all back.

scenes.headline: Ask your documents
bullets: Answers from what's in your files
scenes.record: Open the assistant, type 'When is my Lydec bill due and how much is it?', wait for the answer with its source chips, tap one. Then a quick pass over the Bills tab.
sentences: And when you cannot remember which file it was, you just ask.
When is my Lydec bill due, and how much is it.
Five bills, the amounts, the dates, all of them already late. It takes that straight from the documents, and shows you which ones it used.

scenes.headline: Librarian runs on RevenueCat
scenes.record: Fresh install (or signed-out Test Store user). Tap the locked Documents tab, show the paywall prices, buy the annual plan through the Test Store dialog, land on the unlocked tab. Then Me tab: sign in with email, open 'Help with my subscription'.
sentences: The scanner and the P D F tools are free. No ads, no account, nothing nagging you.
The part that reads and files for you is the paid side, and it runs on RevenueCat.
Every price comes live from the offering, and the savings badge is worked out from the real products.
Sign in, and RevenueCat carries that purchase to your next phone.

scenes.headline: A real scanner and fourteen PDF tools
bullets: Scan with edge detection and OCR
scenes.record: Home: tap Scan and capture a page. Then Reorder: long-press a page thumbnail and drag it. Then Sign: draw a signature and place it on a page.
sentences: Underneath it all is a proper scanner. Edges, perspective, text recognition.
And fourteen P D F tools. Drag pages into order, sign one, split, merge, shrink, lock.
Most people come for that. They stay because they stop losing things.
If you are a student, this is the pile that ruins your week. Scholarship forms, insurance, the clinic note, rent receipts.
Dewey keeps all of it where you can find it in seconds, in whatever language it arrived in.
That is Dewey. It finds the file you cannot name.
